name: Do older homes across the Denver metro area require special tub removal methods?

mainEntity.name: Do older homes across the Denver metro area require special tub removal methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, older Denver area homes in neighborhoods like historic Denver or older parts of Littleton frequently feature heavy cast iron tubs set into thick lath and mortar surrounds. These installations require specialized care during removal to avoid cracking fragile plaster walls or damaging vintage cast iron plumbing stacks. Professional crews also inspect the floor joists once the tub is out, as historic framing may require reinforcement to support modern replacements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, older metro homes often have cast iron tubs in wire-and-plaster walls that require sectional demolition and careful plumbing disconnection to protect vintage piping.
